people.name: Boaz
people.line: Kinsman-redeemer who married Ruth, ancestor of David and Jesus

people.name: Ruth
people.line: Moabite woman, ancestor of David and Jesus

translations.web: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife; and he went in to her, and Yahweh enabled her to conceive, and she bore a son.
translations.bsb: So Boaz took Ruth, and she became his wife. And when he had relations with her, the LORD enabled her to conceive, and she gave birth to a son.
translations.kjv: So Boaz took Ruth, and she was his wife: and when he went in unto her, the LORD gave her conception, and she bare a son.
translations.asv: So Boaz took Ruth, and she became his wife; and he went in unto her, and Jehovah gave her conception, and she bare a son.
